note: Minimal golden suite v0 (2026-09-29), mock mode, no AWS. Extended to the full 45-case suite on the 11 Oct task (WEEK2_PLAN). Independent-mode plan_sale cases only: contract-mode is a stateful multi-call flow (switch mode, save terms), covered by tests/contract/test_sale_tools.py instead of this single-call runner. Multi-step cases (2026-09-29, health triage): `steps` run in order on one session; `save` keeps a result field for later steps (`$name`); `poll_until` repeats a read-only step until the agent's slow path finishes; `model_fixture` runs the case against a server whose model is a test fixture (tests/fakes.py), to prove the safety floor and fail-loud paths. `fresh_state` (2026-09-30, daily briefing) runs a case on a server of its own, so earlier cases' health checks cannot change its answer. Follow-up and contract-terms cases (2026-10-01, build session 4): a step may set `demo_days_later` (the demo clock, in process: only this runner can; no MCP tool can), `say` (a sentence run through the Simulator's own intent rules; the matched tool and arguments are sent), `answer_word` (haan/avunu/nahi/vaddu turned into yes/no by the same rules) and `expect_error` (the call must be refused).
